song.title: Free Fallin' (Live at the Nokia Theatre)

guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Two-Tone Sunburst signature) / PRS Silver Sky
guitar.notes: Confirmed — John Mayer has had a long-documented signature relationship with Fender Stratocasters and more recently PRS Silver Sky.

tone.target: clean layered acoustic-electric shimmer with light breakup
tone.profile: clean layered acoustic-electric shimmer with light breakup
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain focusing on compression for clarity, a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) for sparkle, light overdrive for edge, and room reverb/delay for spaciousness.

rig.name: John Mayer - Free Fallin' (Live at the Nokia Theatre) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Even out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios and enhance clarity.
Provide a subtle, warm edge-of-breakup without thick crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its gentle breakup character, mimicking the light grit needed for acoustic-electric tones.
The Green OD handles the required grit; no dedicated high-gain stomp is necessary.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a clean, bright Fender-style amp for maximum sparkle and clarity.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the clean US Deluxe tone.
Slightly boost the high end and clarity to emphasize the 'sparkle' of arpeggios.
Avoid chorus wash as per the 'avoid' list.
blocks.gap: The Chorus module is explicitly bypassed to prevent unwanted washing effects.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle, non-intrusive echo for spaciousness.
blocks.gap: The delay is kept minimal (low feedback/mix) to avoid 'big delay' while providing necessary ambience.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle room ambience and depth without sounding artificial.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance acoustic-electric clarity and realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance the natural sparkle and attack of fingerpicked arpeggios.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and realism in high frequencies.
